summary: Current main still flattened every TRT-LLM sparse-MLA query token into the batch dimension and called the trtllm-gen decode kernel without enforcing CUDA's gridDim.z limit. Added a pre-launch fail-loud guard at the shared launch choke point and regression coverage for the exact 65535/65536 onset plus independent neighboring and ordinary batch sizes. The original NVIDIA B200 kernel failure could not be executed on the assigned AMD gfx950 GPU.

tests.what_was_measured: Regression failed before the fix because the base tree had no TRT-LLM MLA batch-limit validation helper; raw collection failure is retained in raw/regression_before.log.
Seven cases passed: 1, 1024, 65534, and 65535 are accepted; 65536, 65537, and 131072 raise ValueError before launch.
Changed helper and regression test compile successfully with the prepared interpreter.
No whitespace errors in the patch.

tests.command: prepared Python gfx950 torch matmul compared with an independent CPU reference
tests.what_was_measured: A real GPU float32 identity matmul on AMD Instinct MI350X produced max_abs_error=0.0; this only validates assigned-GPU execution and is not evidence for the NVIDIA TRT-LLM bug.
The prepared environment does not contain the black or isort Python modules; logs retain the exact tool-availability failure.

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-86dd53ce3404/raw/gpu_sanity.log records torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executing on AMD Instinct MI350X with zero numerical error; gpu_architecture.log records gfx950. The affected trtllm-gen CUDA kernel is unavailable on this architecture.

remaining_limitations: The assigned GPU is AMD gfx950, not NVIDIA SM100/B200, so the reported FlashInfer trtllm-gen CUDA launch and sentinel-output behavior were not reproduced locally.
No DeepSeek-V3.2-style DSA checkpoint was supplied, so bench_one_batch and HTTP serving reproduction were not performed.

This is a fail-loud safety correction, not the capability fix: unchunked TRT-LLM sparse-MLA forwards above 65535 flattened query rows are rejected and still require chunking or cum_seq_lens_q adoption.
Upstream SGLang PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34948 and FlashInfer PR https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/4536 remain open and unmerged as of inspection.
